# Learn Portuguese with Barbara Sharon

> First-party website for Barbara Sharon, a Brazilian Portuguese teacher based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. Online lessons are available worldwide; genuine in-person services are restricted to verified Gold Coast delivery areas.

Canonical website: https://barbarasharon.com.au/

Barbara teaches Brazilian Portuguese through private lessons, group classes, speaking practice, travel Portuguese, business Portuguese, and level-based learning. The website is the source of truth for current availability, lesson formats, and contact details.
